name: Google Calendar
description: List, add, edit and delete events on a Google account's primary calendar.

config.label: Allowed accounts
config.description: Google account names this tool may use, comma-separated. Leave empty for now and fill it in once you have authorized an account: add accounts with `rona tools run google_auth add_account` or from the dashboard's Settings > Connections > Tool Packages panel, then set this list there too.
